description: This Java class 'SqlJdbcUtil' provides utility methods for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and binding parameters for database operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SqlJdbcUtil
classes.description: Utility class for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and parameter binding within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFromClause
methods.description: Constructs the SQL FROM clause, including JOINs for view entities based on join style.

methods.name: makeWhereStringFromFields
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause string with conditions based on provided fields and operators.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a complete WHERE clause, combining field conditions and view entity conditions.

methods.name: makeViewWhereClause
methods.description: Generates the WHERE clause for view entities based on join style.

methods.name: filterColName
methods.description: Sanitizes column names by replacing special characters with underscores.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Binds entity field values to an SQL statement via SQLProcessor.

methods.name: setValuesWhereClause
methods.description: Binds non-null entity field values to an SQL statement for WHERE clause.

methods.name: setPkValues
methods.description: Binds primary key values of an entity to an SQL statement.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a value from a ResultSet into an entity's field, handling various SQL types.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Binds a Java object value to an SQL statement parameter, handling type conversions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Maps Java type names to internal type codes.

methods.name: addValueSingle
methods.description: Appends a single value or placeholder to an SQL condition string, adding to parameters list if applicable.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Appends a collection of values or a single value to an SQL condition string, handling parameter binding.
